Man killed by armed men in Manipur's Kangpokpi district

A 53-year-old Kuki farmer was shot dead by suspected militants in Kangpokpi district, Manipur. His wife, who was present during the incident, managed to escape unharmed. The incident occurred in a region that has seen ongoing ethnic tensions.
